name: Sling Chair
promptName: Leather Sling Lounge Chair with Walnut Frame
legacyNames: Leather Sling Lounge Chair with Walnut Frame
description: A low lounge chair on a solid walnut frame, with a single suspended saddle-leather sling forming the seat and back in one continuous unbroken curve, secured by brass pins at the frame ends.
materials: Solid oiled walnut frame with visible open grain and hand-shaped tapers, one thick vegetable-tanned saddle-leather sling in warm tan, brass sling pins and slotted brass screws.
primaryColors: Warm tan saddle leather, dark oiled walnut, brass hardware
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, brand stamp or tooled pattern on the leather; never add cushions, straps, buttons or a headrest; never split the sling into separate seat and back panels, it is one continuous piece. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the same low four-leg walnut frame with its hand-shaped tapers, the single continuous saddle-leather sling curving unbroken from back rail to front rail, and the brass sling pins at the frame ends consistent across all five angles.
